rationale: The plan identifies the question as the condition:time interaction and tests it with the DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time, matching the reference exactly, with per-time-point interaction contrasts shrunk by ashr (correctly noting apeglm is coefficient-only) to describe the pattern. QC is blind-VST PCA, distance heatmap and library sizes coloured by condition and time with a stated flag-only policy; the pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, smallest group) is minimal and justified; normalization stays inside the model with a sensible handling of the missing length offset. Reference levels are set explicitly but the condition reference level is not named in the plan itself, a small gap. BH at alpha 0.05 with selection by padj only, enrichment correctly omitted and justified, and the report specifies versions, formulas, thresholds, tested/significant counts, power and length-offset caveats, plus sessionInfo; the edgeR intersection arm is an unrequested extra but does not compromise the primary analysis.
